```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| results: hide
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  year = 2020,
  state = "TX",
  geometry = TRUE,
  key = "a07e75395383876b8ff28b168b696572a39e0566"
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c("B15003_001", "B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025"),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020,
  key = "a07e75395383876b8ff28b168b696572a39e0566"
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(median_age = "B01002_001", population = "B01003_001"),
  year = 2020,
  state = "CA",
  geometry = FALSE,
  key = "a07e75395383876b8ff28b168b696572a39e0566"
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 14
#| fig-width: 10
edu_state %>%
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) %>%
  summarise(
    total_adults = sum(estimate[variable == "B15003_001"], na.rm = TRUE),
    bachelors_or_higher = sum(
      estimate[variable %in% c("B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025")],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage_bachelors_or_higher = 100 * bachelors_or_higher / total_adults
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = percentage_bachelors_or_higher,
    y = reorder(NAME, percentage_bachelors_or_higher)
  )) +
  geom_col(fill = "#31688e") +
  labs(
    title = "Bachelor's-or-Higher Attainment by State",
    subtitle = "2020 ACS 5-year estimates",
    x = "Adults with at least a bachelor's degree",
    y = "State",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey35"),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "grey35", hjust = 0),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
county_age <- age_ca %>%
  select(GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = variable,
    values_from = estimate,
    names_glue = "{variable}"
  )

ggplot(county_age, aes(x = population, y = median_age)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, color = "#31688e") +
  geom_text(
    data = slice_max(county_age, population, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE),
    aes(label = NAME),
    hjust = -0.05,
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "County Population and Median Age in California",
    x = "County population (log scale)",
    y = "Median age (years)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "grey35", hjust = 0),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
